Jonah T.: Heads upCandidate Tina R is arriving from ORD at 8:20am and the onsite loop starts at 9:30am. Flight delay flagged; asking if we can change start to 10:00am or provide a quiet room for a 20-min prep.
Priya N.: If delay is 8:20 arrival, travel to office ~50 mins. I'd suggest bump to 10:00 to avoid rushing. Do we have buffer in panel schedules?
Sam (People Ops): We can shift main loop to 10:00. I'll message the panel and update calendar. Also offering a $40 transit stipend or rideshare; ask candidate preference.
Jonah T.: Please also note Tina requested a standing desk and low-fructose snack due to medical needs.
Priya N.: Standing desk available on 4th floor kit & we've got bananas and almonds in the cafe. But low-fructose specificallywe have apples? Might be worth checking.
Sam (People Ops): Approved standing desk and will mark dietary as low-fructose. I'll ping facilities to prepare.
ops-bot: Calendar updated: new start time 10:00 AM PT; notifications sent to all panelists.
Jonah T.: For the coding task, she prefers VS Code and has a mac workflow. Do we have a Mac laptop loaner with Apple keyboard and USB-C?
Priya N.: We have MacBook loaner "MB-Loaner-12" in assets; reserve for her.
Sam (People Ops): Reserved MB-Loaner-12. Will include a spare power adapter and USB-C ethernet dongle.
Jonah T.: Candidate asked about travel expense process for mileage (she's driving from Oakland) and parking validation.
Sam (People Ops): For mileage, ask for odometer start/stop + receipt; we reimburse per company policy. For parking, we'll validate at front desk and provide voucher. I'll include instructions in confirmation email.
Priya N.: Also add note: remind candidate to bring ID for building access and that badge pick-up is at the receptionist.
Sam (People Ops): Copy. I'll send a short message to candidate with revised schedule, transit options, expense instructions, and accessibility accommodations.
Jonah T.: Thanks folks. If panels need to slide, I'll be on standby to cover.
Priya N.: Got it. Sending courtesy Slack DM to panel leads.
Sam (People Ops): Final checklist I'll send to ops channel: standing desk, loaner Mac, snacks, parking voucher, updated calendar, expense form link. 
Jonah T.: :thumbsup:
